steps.title: The money: local saves the bill, and the screen shows what it costs

items.text: Local saves money, and the screen shows what it costs. Against claude-sonnet-5-5 at 1,000 tasks/day: all local on evo-x2 saves USD 306.10 a month at 80/90 (88.9%) correct versus 90/90 (100.0%) all-cloud, and 10 wrong answers are silent. The only measured detector, window overflow, escalates 0 tasks at this window. Catching in-window wrong answers needs a verifier we do not claim; the dotted line is that ceiling, no such detector.
items.label: measured

items.text: Fix after the fact: about 2 cents (mean USD 0.0227 per task, cache-priced), 84.8% fixed (95% Wilson CI 79.1% to 89.1%), but executed actions cannot be undone; decide up front instead. 28 of the 30 unfixed inherited the local model's earlier executed actions. (Full-history redo on claude-sonnet-5-5, up to 2048 output tokens per call; the local run had 384.)
items.label: measured

items.text: evo-t2s Intel CPU at 4096 (projected, from evo-x2's 4096 tier): the window flag escalates 88 tasks and reaches 90/90, but the hybrid costs USD 359.80/month MORE than all-cloud against claude-sonnet-5-5 at 1,000 tasks/day: escalating with the full history costs more per task than a fresh cloud run
items.label: projected

items.text: Late full-history escalation costs 1.76x a fresh cloud run of the same task on the mean (1.64x on the median; matched over 119 rows, 53 tasks; 2.22x / 1.87x unmatched) on claude-sonnet-5-5
items.label: measured

items.text: Against claude-haiku-5-5 the escalation cost is interim (its all-cloud price): the full-history redo ran on claude-sonnet-5-5 only.
One long agent task (nebius-rebench-openhands, median 62 steps) sent whole to the cloud: USD 2.53 median on claude-sonnet-5-5 at an assumed 70% cache hit rate
